subject: Demo coordination during spring-forward week — timezone windows
messages:
From: Emma Jung <emma.jung@finbank.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <r.singh@cloudedge.ai>
Date: 2026-03-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Coordinating next-week demo across US/EU/APAC

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Our team at FinBank is keen to see Redwood in action. We have execs in the US (SF), EU (Berlin), and APAC (Singapore) who want to attend, and we need to lock a time that works across those zones.

A couple of constraints: our COO prefers demos before EOD PST for the US participants, while the engineering leads in Berlin prefer late morning CET. Also — note the US moves clocks this weekend (spring forward on Sun Mar 8) and that will create one-off offset mismatches with EU/APAC. Can you confirm whether Redwood has any internal blackout windows that week (holidays, channel maintenance, or reduced staffing)?

Proposed rough windows (we're flexible):
- Option A: 2026-03-10 08:30 PST / 16:30 CET / 23:30 SGT (later APAC — ok if recording is fine)
- Option B: 2026-03-10 11:00 PST / 19:00 CET / 02:00 SGT (late for APAC)
- Option C: 2026-03-11 07:00 PST / 15:00 CET / 22:00 SGT (earlier EU than usual)

We can also run two shorter sessions split by region if that makes logistics easier. Please send a calendar invite or tell us a preferred slot and your suggested meeting length (30/45/60 min).

Attachments: calendar_prefs.ics (we exported our preferred windows), security-checklist.pdf (redacted checklist for SOC2 questions)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Emma Jung
VP, Platform Strategy
FinBank

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jung <emma.jung@finbank.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <r.singh@cloudedge.ai>
Date: 2026-03-08T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating next-week demo across US/EU/APAC

Hi Emma —

Thanks — this is super helpful. Quick answers up front:
- No planned platform maintenance or org-wide holidays at Redwood that week; engineering and solutions will be available.
- You are right about the DST mismatch: the US spring-forward on 2026-03-08 will shift US timestamps an hour ahead of EU until Europe moves later in March. That often causes one-off calendar confusion during the second week of March.

To keep it simple and avoid any clock-handoff surprises, I suggest two approaches and a fallback:
1) Single global session timed for US morning / EU late afternoon so APAC can watch the recording (Option A from you looks closest).
2) Two regional cut-down demos: one targeting US/EU overlap and a second shorter APAC-friendly session (we can do 30m APAC + 45m US/EU).
3) Fallback: propose a single time but send region-specific invites explicitly labelled with local time (we do this to avoid calendar clients auto-adjusting incorrectly).

For availability, we can do these times on 2026-03-10:
- 2026-03-10 08:30 PST / 16:30 CET / 23:30 SGT — 60 minutes — Lead solutions + Eng on call
- 2026-03-10 10:00 PST / 18:00 CET / 01:00 SGT (next day) — 45 minutes — lighter engineering presence

If either of those work, I will send region-labelled calendar invites and include a short note on the DST mismatch so recipients don't rely solely on their client convert. Also attaching a short security checklist and the calendar_prefs.ics you provided so we can mirror your export.

Proposed next step: pick the preferred slot or say split sessions and we'll lock invites.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: security-checklist.pdf (stub), calendar_prefs.ics (invite)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-09T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: FinBank demo slot — need sign-off on staffing and recording plan

Monica / Jonas —

Looping you in on FinBank. They asked for cross-region coverage next week; Emma highlighted the US spring-forward complication. Proposed external slots: 2026-03-10 08:30 PST (global session) or split session approach.

Q's for ops:
- Monica: can solutions cover a 60-min global session at 08:30 PST (that's 16:30 CET)? That would require Jonas + one SWE for live Q&A.
- Jonas: are you ok with being on the 60-min call at 16:30 CET? We will record and schedule a 30-min APAC follow-up recorded session if APAC attendance is small.

If yes, I'll confirm Option A with FinBank and send region-labelled invites (explicit local times). If you'd prefer split sessions, say so — we can do 45m + 30m but need another solutions SE for APAC.

Thanks — will hold the slot tentatively until 16:00 PST today.

Rishi

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jung <emma.jung@finbank.com>, Rajiv Singh <r.singh@cloudedge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-10T16:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating next-week demo across US/EU/APAC — confirmed slot and invites sent

Hi Emma / Rajiv —

Thanks for the quick replies and for sharing the calendar export. Confirming we will run the global demo as follows:

- Date/time (US-labelled): 2026-03-10 08:30 Pacific Daylight Time (PDT) — note: US has moved clocks forward, so calendar will show PDT
- Date/time (EU-labelled): 2026-03-10 16:30 Central European Time (CET) — Europe has not yet changed clocks, so local label is CET
- Meeting length: 60 minutes (45m demo + 15m live Q&A)

I just sent three region-labelled calendar invites: one explicitly marked "FinBank — Demo (US timezone) — 08:30 PDT", one "FinBank — Demo (EU timezone) — 16:30 CET", and one "FinBank — Demo (APAC recording) — recording link after call". Please accept the invite that matches your calendar client and location. We did this to avoid client-side DST conversions causing recipients to appear one hour off.

Logistics and attachments included in the invite: dial-in + conferencing link, short recordings consent note, and the security-checklist.pdf. We will record the session and follow up with a 30-min APAC-tailored recap the next day if needed.

If you want a separate APAC live session instead of the recording, we can schedule a 30-min slot on 2026-03-11 at 22:00 SGT — say the word and we'll staff it.

Looking forward to the demo.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
